notes.text: "M0 beliefs: regime uncertain-leaning-loose after 5kH reservation fill despite tight headline and 2.19x spot/index

"M1 beliefs: regime Loose (~92% prob given 4k H shipment, 5kH reservation fill, -6.7% index drop to .493M, and price-cut news) | Gen N launch m17-18 | inf growth uncertain (m0=5.67kH) | brokers A/B awaiting first probe results. Plan: W1 already covered (~135 kH-m), ordering 6k H pre-m5 export-control window for W2/W3 base, second 0.1k broker probes, sign W2 power next month."

"M2 beliefs: regime ~60% Loose / 40% Tight (index +3.6% to .547M, rival-adjusted spot ~1.52x index) | Gen N launch m17-18 | inf growth leaning 7% (~68% prob after m1=6.85kH) | brokers A & B both ~72% reliable (1/1 delivered).
